name: Visibility Mesh
summary: Shopify app that audits how well AI assistants and search engines can read your store and lists fixes for products, collections, pages, schema, llms.txt and crawler access, with a competitor comparison and backlink audit.
best_for: Shopify store owners who want a concrete list of what to change so AI assistants and search engines can read their products, collections and pages, and who will act on it themselves or through a developer
skip_if: you want guaranteed traffic or AI citations, you have no time or developer to act on a fix list and the $179 Growth plan is too much, or your store is not on Shopify
honest_knock: It is young and small: launched on the Shopify App Store on 10 July 2026, with a handful of reviews. AI-search visibility is hard to measure and the vendor itself promises no rankings, citations, traffic or sales, so you are paying for an audit and a fix list, not an outcome. Only Growth at $179 applies fixes; on the lower plans the work is yours. The cancellation policy on its website still names older plan names (Essential, Advanced, Agency) and rules out partial-month refunds.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Starter · per month, Shopify app billed every 30 days in USD
pricing.notes: (read 2026-10-25 on the Shopify App Store listing apps.shopify.com/visibility-mesh and on the vendor's app page at visibilitymesh.com/pages/shopify-app) Three plans, billed in USD through Shopify every 30 days, each with a 7-day free trial that includes one full scan. Starter is $29 a month: every issue with step-by-step fixes, 12 rescans a month and a backlink audit of up to 30 links. Pro is $79: everything in Starter plus a deep catalog scan, a competitor benchmark, AI traffic tracking, a backlink audit of up to 150 links and 25 rescans a month. Growth is $179: everything in Pro plus approving and applying fixes from the app with undo, FAQ and blog content, a backlink audit of up to 500 links and a priority queue. The vendor also sells separate web audits outside the Shopify app; those are not part of these plans.

schema_offer.description: Starter, Shopify app billed every 30 days in USD; Starter $29 (all issues with step-by-step fixes, 12 rescans/mo, backlink audit up to 30 links); Pro $79 (deep catalog scan, competitor benchmark, AI traffic tracking, 150 links, 25 rescans); Growth $179 (approve-and-apply fixes with undo, FAQ and blog content, 500 links, priority queue); 7-day free trial including one full scan. Read on the vendor's own pricing page on 2026-10-25.

compare_with.name: Omniseo
compare_with.why: Omniseo is in our dossiers: Essentials was $89 a month for 4 AI channels and 50 tracked prompts when we re-read it on 20 October 2026, and it measures how a brand shows up in AI answers across platforms. Visibility Mesh is Shopify-only and starts from your store's own content, fixing products, collections, schema and llms.txt from $29 a month (read 25 October 2026). Omniseo fits a team that wants to track AI mentions for any website; Visibility Mesh fits a Shopify store that wants the fixes.
